templates.description: What do I know about a person, including their birthday, residence, job, contacts, allergies, interests, organizations, and memberships?
templates.sql: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.relationship, p.birthday, p.residence, p.job_details, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('type',c.type,'value',c.value,'is_primary',c.is_primary)) FROM contact_methods c WHERE c.person_id=p.id) AS contacts, (SELECT json_group_array(a.allergen) FROM allergies a WHERE a.person_id=p.id) AS allergies, (SELECT json_group_array(i.interest) FROM interests i WHERE i.person_id=p.id) AS interests, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('organization',o.name,'role',om.role,'start_date',om.start_date)) FROM organization_memberships om JOIN organizations o ON o.id=om.organization_id WHERE om.person_id=p.id) AS organization_roles, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('place',pl.name,'category',m.category,'amount',m.amount,'currency',m.currency,'billing_period',m.billing_period,'status',m.status,'end_date',m.end_date)) FROM memberships m JOIN places pl ON pl.id=m.place_id WHERE m.person_id=p.id) AS place_memberships FROM people p WHERE (:person IS NULL OR p.id=:person) ORDER BY p.name

templates.description: What are people's phone numbers or email addresses, and whose is a particular contact detail?
templates.sql: SELECT p.id AS person_id, p.name, p.relationship, c.id AS contact_id, c.type, c.value, c.is_primary FROM contact_methods c JOIN people p ON p.id=c.person_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR p.id=:person) AND (:type IS NULL OR c.type=:type) AND (:value IS NULL OR c.value=:value) ORDER BY p.name,c.type,c.is_primary DESC

templates.description: When are people's birthdays, including a particular person's birthday?
templates.sql: SELECT id AS person_id,name,relationship,birthday,residence FROM people WHERE birthday IS NOT NULL AND (:person IS NULL OR id=:person) ORDER BY birthday,name

templates.description: When and how did I interact with a person during a period?
templates.sql: SELECT i.id,p.name AS person,i.category,i.date,o.name AS organization FROM interactions i JOIN people p ON p.id=i.person_id LEFT JOIN organizations o ON CAST(i.organization_id AS INTEGER)=o.id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR i.person_id=:person) AND (:start IS NULL OR i.date>=:start) AND (:end IS NULL OR i.date<=:end) ORDER BY i.date DESC,i.id DESC

templates.description: What lease terms and addresses are recorded, and who is associated with each lease?
templates.sql: SELECT l.id,l.address,l.start_date,l.rent_amount,l.currency,l.billing_period,l.rent_due_day,l.security_deposit,p.name AS associated_person FROM leases l LEFT JOIN people p ON p.id=l.person_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR l.person_id=:person) ORDER BY l.start_date DESC

templates.description: Which places does a person have or previously had a membership at, and what does each membership cost?
templates.sql: SELECT m.id,p.name AS person,pl.name AS place,m.category,m.amount,m.currency,m.billing_period,m.status,m.end_date FROM memberships m JOIN people p ON p.id=m.person_id JOIN places pl ON pl.id=m.place_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR m.person_id=:person) AND (:place IS NULL OR m.place_id=:place) ORDER BY p.name,CASE WHEN m.status='active' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,pl.name

templates.description: What meetings, appointments, calls, and travel were scheduled in a period, including their status and booking details?
templates.sql: SELECT e.id,e.category,e.title,e.start_datetime,e.end_datetime,e.location,o.name AS organization,p.name AS organizer,e.status,e.return_date,e.travel_mode,e.participants,e.check_in_date,e.check_out_date,e.guests,e.total_amount,e.currency,e.departure_date,e.origin,e.destination FROM events e LEFT JOIN organizations o ON o.id=e.organization_id LEFT JOIN people p ON p.id=e.organizer_person_id WHERE (:category IS NULL OR e.category=:category) AND (:organization IS NULL OR e.organization_id=:organization) AND (:person IS NULL OR e.organizer_person_id=:person) AND (:start IS NULL OR date(COALESCE(e.end_datetime,e.return_date,e.check_out_date,e.start_datetime))>=:start) AND (:end IS NULL OR date(e.start_datetime)<=:end) ORDER BY e.start_datetime,e.id

templates.description: What non-cancelled plans, meetings, or trips fall in a period?
templates.sql: SELECT e.id,e.category,e.title,e.start_datetime,e.end_datetime,e.location,o.name AS organization,p.name AS organizer,e.status,e.return_date,e.travel_mode,e.participants,e.check_in_date,e.check_out_date,e.guests,e.total_amount,e.currency,e.departure_date,e.origin,e.destination FROM events e LEFT JOIN organizations o ON o.id=e.organization_id LEFT JOIN people p ON p.id=e.organizer_person_id WHERE (e.status IS NULL OR e.status NOT IN ('cancelled','deleted')) AND (:start IS NULL OR date(COALESCE(e.end_datetime,e.return_date,e.check_out_date,e.start_datetime))>=:start) AND (:end IS NULL OR date(e.start_datetime)<=:end) ORDER BY e.start_datetime,e.id

templates.description: How many events of each type and status were scheduled in a period?
templates.sql: SELECT e.category,COALESCE(e.status,'unspecified') AS status,COUNT(*) AS event_count,MIN(e.start_datetime) AS first_start,MAX(e.start_datetime) AS last_start FROM events e WHERE (:start IS NULL OR date(e.start_datetime)>=:start) AND (:end IS NULL OR date(e.start_datetime)<=:end) GROUP BY e.category,e.status ORDER BY event_count DESC,e.category,e.status

templates.description: What purchases or payments were made in a period, optionally at a merchant, of a kind, or with a companion?
templates.sql: SELECT id,date,transaction_datetime,category,merchant,item,amount,currency,companion,location,card_last_four FROM expenses WHERE (:start IS NULL OR date>=:start) AND (:end IS NULL OR date<=:end) AND (:category IS NULL OR category=:category) AND (:merchant IS NULL OR merchant=:merchant) AND (:companion IS NULL OR companion=:companion) ORDER BY date DESC,transaction_datetime DESC,id DESC

templates.description: How much did I spend in a period, optionally for one kind of expense or merchant?
templates.sql: SELECT currency,COUNT(*) AS expense_count,SUM(amount) AS total_amount,MIN(date) AS first_date,MAX(date) AS last_date FROM expenses WHERE (:start IS NULL OR date>=:start) AND (:end IS NULL OR date<=:end) AND (:category IS NULL OR category=:category) AND (:merchant IS NULL OR merchant=:merchant) GROUP BY currency ORDER BY currency

templates.description: How much did I spend on each kind of expense in a period?
templates.sql: SELECT category,currency,COUNT(*) AS expense_count,SUM(amount) AS total_amount,MIN(date) AS first_date,MAX(date) AS last_date FROM expenses WHERE (:start IS NULL OR date>=:start) AND (:end IS NULL OR date<=:end) GROUP BY category,currency ORDER BY currency,total_amount DESC,category

templates.description: How much did I spend at each merchant in a period, optionally for one expense category?
templates.sql: SELECT merchant,currency,COUNT(*) AS expense_count,SUM(amount) AS total_amount,MIN(date) AS first_date,MAX(date) AS last_date FROM expenses WHERE (:start IS NULL OR date>=:start) AND (:end IS NULL OR date<=:end) AND (:category IS NULL OR category=:category) GROUP BY merchant,currency ORDER BY currency,total_amount DESC,merchant

templates.description: How much spending was associated with each companion in a period?
templates.sql: SELECT companion,currency,COUNT(*) AS expense_count,SUM(amount) AS total_amount,MIN(date) AS first_date,MAX(date) AS last_date FROM expenses WHERE companion IS NOT NULL AND (:start IS NULL OR date>=:start) AND (:end IS NULL OR date<=:end) GROUP BY companion,currency ORDER BY currency,total_amount DESC,companion

templates.description: What were my largest individual expenses in a period, separately ranked within each currency?
templates.sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT e.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY amount DESC,date DESC,id DESC) AS rank_in_currency FROM expenses e WHERE (:start IS NULL OR date>=:start) AND (:end IS NULL OR date<=:end) AND (:category IS NULL OR category=:category)) SELECT rank_in_currency,id,date,transaction_datetime,category,merchant,item,amount,currency,companion,location,card_last_four FROM ranked WHERE rank_in_currency<=10 ORDER BY currency,rank_in_currency

templates.description: What physical activities did I do in a period, and where and with whom?
templates.sql: SELECT w.id,w.date,w.category,w.activity,pl.name AS place,w.companion FROM workouts w LEFT JOIN places pl ON pl.id=w.place_id WHERE (:start IS NULL OR w.date>=:start) AND (:end IS NULL OR w.date<=:end) AND (:category IS NULL OR w.category=:category) AND (:place IS NULL OR w.place_id=:place) ORDER BY w.date DESC,w.id DESC

templates.description: How often did I do each kind of physical activity in a period, and when was the latest one?
templates.sql: SELECT w.category,COUNT(*) AS workout_count,COUNT(DISTINCT w.date) AS active_days,MIN(w.date) AS first_date,MAX(w.date) AS latest_date FROM workouts w WHERE (:start IS NULL OR w.date>=:start) AND (:end IS NULL OR w.date<=:end) GROUP BY w.category ORDER BY workout_count DESC,w.category

templates.description: What were my fastest recorded 5 km and 10 km runs in a period?
templates.sql: WITH parsed AS (SELECT w.id,w.date,w.activity,CAST(substr(w.activity,1,instr(w.activity,' km in ')-1) AS INTEGER) AS distance_km,substr(w.activity,instr(w.activity,' km in ')+7) AS time_text FROM workouts w WHERE w.category='running' AND w.activity GLOB '[0-9]* km in [0-9]*:[0-9]*' AND (:start IS NULL OR w.date>=:start) AND (:end IS NULL OR w.date<=:end)), timed AS (SELECT *,60*CAST(substr(time_text,1,instr(time_text,':')-1) AS INTEGER)+CAST(substr(time_text,instr(time_text,':')+1,2) AS INTEGER) AS seconds FROM parsed), ranked AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY distance_km ORDER BY seconds,date,id) AS run_rank FROM timed) SELECT distance_km,date,activity,seconds,id AS workout_id FROM ranked WHERE run_rank=1 ORDER BY distance_km

templates.description: Which books have I tracked or read, when did I start them, and how did I rate them?
templates.sql: SELECT id,title,author,status,started_date,rating FROM books WHERE (:book IS NULL OR id=:book) AND (:author IS NULL OR author=:author) AND (:status IS NULL OR status=:status) AND (:start IS NULL OR started_date>=:start) AND (:end IS NULL OR started_date<=:end) ORDER BY started_date DESC,title,id

templates.description: How many books did I start in a period, and which received my highest ratings?
templates.sql: SELECT status,COUNT(*) AS book_count,COUNT(rating) AS rated_count,ROUND(AVG(rating),2) AS average_rating,MAX(rating) AS highest_rating,MIN(started_date) AS earliest_start,MAX(started_date) AS latest_start FROM books WHERE (:start IS NULL OR started_date>=:start) AND (:end IS NULL OR started_date<=:end) GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

templates.description: What tasks or reminders are due in a period, who are they about, and are they done or pending?
templates.sql: SELECT t.id,t.title,t.due_date,t.status,p.name AS person,o.name AS organization FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN people p ON p.id=CAST(t.person_id AS INTEGER) LEFT JOIN organizations o ON o.id=CAST(t.organization_id AS INTEGER) WHERE (:task IS NULL OR t.id=:task) AND (:status IS NULL OR t.status=:status) AND (:person IS NULL OR CAST(t.person_id AS INTEGER)=:person) AND (:organization IS NULL OR CAST(t.organization_id AS INTEGER)=:organization) AND (:start IS NULL OR t.due_date>=:start) AND (:end IS NULL OR t.due_date<=:end) ORDER BY t.due_date,t.id

templates.description: How many tasks of each status are due in a period?
templates.sql: SELECT status,COUNT(*) AS task_count,MIN(due_date) AS earliest_due,MAX(due_date) AS latest_due FROM tasks WHERE (:start IS NULL OR due_date>=:start) AND (:end IS NULL OR due_date<=:end) GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

templates.description: What is an organization, who works there, and what funding, events, and emails are associated with it?
templates.sql: SELECT o.id,o.name,o.category,(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('person',p.name,'role',om.role,'start_date',om.start_date)) FROM organization_memberships om JOIN people p ON p.id=om.person_id WHERE om.organization_id=o.id) AS people_and_roles,(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('category',f.category,'amount',f.amount,'currency',f.currency,'status',f.status,'announced_date',f.announced_date,'lead_person',p.name)) FROM funding_rounds f LEFT JOIN people p ON p.id=f.lead_person_id WHERE f.organization_id=o.id) AS associated_funding,(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('title',e.title,'start_datetime',e.start_datetime,'status',e.status)) FROM events e WHERE e.organization_id=o.id) AS events,(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('subject',em.subject,'datetime',em.datetime,'body_details',em.body_details)) FROM emails em WHERE em.organization_id=o.id) AS emails FROM organizations o WHERE (:organization IS NULL OR o.id=:organization) AND (:category IS NULL OR o.category=:category) ORDER BY o.name

templates.description: Who belongs to an organization, and what are their roles and contact details?
templates.sql: SELECT o.name AS organization,o.category AS organization_category,p.name AS person,p.relationship,p.job_details,om.role,om.start_date,(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('type',c.type,'value',c.value,'is_primary',c.is_primary)) FROM contact_methods c WHERE c.person_id=p.id) AS contacts FROM organization_memberships om JOIN organizations o ON o.id=om.organization_id JOIN people p ON p.id=om.person_id WHERE (:organization IS NULL OR om.organization_id=:organization) AND (:person IS NULL OR om.person_id=:person) ORDER BY o.name,p.name

templates.description: What fundraising rounds are recorded, for how much, and who led them?
templates.sql: SELECT f.id,f.category,f.amount,f.currency,f.status,f.announced_date,o.name AS associated_organization,p.name AS lead_person FROM funding_rounds f LEFT JOIN organizations o ON o.id=f.organization_id LEFT JOIN people p ON p.id=f.lead_person_id WHERE (:organization IS NULL OR f.organization_id=:organization) AND (:start IS NULL OR f.announced_date>=:start) AND (:end IS NULL OR f.announced_date<=:end) ORDER BY f.announced_date DESC,f.id DESC

templates.description: What does a received or sent email say, and what emails came from a person or concern an organization in a period?
templates.sql: SELECT e.id,e.datetime,e.from_email,e.to_email,e.subject,e.body_details,p.name AS sender_person,o.name AS organization FROM emails e LEFT JOIN people p ON p.id=e.sender_person_id LEFT JOIN organizations o ON o.id=e.organization_id WHERE (:email IS NULL OR e.id=:email) AND (:person IS NULL OR e.sender_person_id=:person) AND (:organization IS NULL OR e.organization_id=:organization) AND (:start IS NULL OR date(e.datetime)>=:start) AND (:end IS NULL OR date(e.datetime)<=:end) ORDER BY e.datetime DESC,e.id DESC

templates.description: What places are recorded, who has a membership there, and what workouts happened there?
templates.sql: SELECT pl.id,pl.name,(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('person',p.name,'category',m.category,'amount',m.amount,'currency',m.currency,'billing_period',m.billing_period,'status',m.status,'end_date',m.end_date)) FROM memberships m JOIN people p ON p.id=m.person_id WHERE m.place_id=pl.id) AS memberships,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workouts w WHERE w.place_id=pl.id) AS workout_count,(SELECT MAX(w.date) FROM workouts w WHERE w.place_id=pl.id) AS latest_workout_date FROM places pl WHERE (:place IS NULL OR pl.id=:place) ORDER BY pl.name
